data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable SQLite session, telemetry, and program provenance data resolved beneath the cross-platform data root.

budget.rationale: Durable program-runtime state is retained for agent provenance and session governance; the ceiling prevents unbounded growth without authorizing automatic deletion.

storage.rationale: Program Runtime owns its durable data directory; temporary session workspaces and external event resources remain outside this storage declaration.

service.name: program-runtime
service.description: Persistent programmatic execution surface where agents submit programs that invoke governed Vrooli operations as typed calls.

hostTools.name: uv
hostTools.reason: Provision the pinned, isolated CPython environment used by the program-runtime kernel.
hostTools.notes: If uv is unavailable, the kernel fails closed with an install remediation and never falls back to host python3.

vrooli-events.description: Optional typed telemetry bus for program lifecycle events.
vrooli-events.degraded_behavior: Program execution remains available; events persist in the local outbox and are retried until vrooli-events returns, with aged failures dead-lettered.

workspace-sandbox.description: Optional copy-on-write workspace binding for session kernels.
workspace-sandbox.degraded_behavior: Sessions without a declared workspace continue with a private scratch directory. Declared workspace identifiers are rejected while workspace-sandbox is unavailable; explicit absolute paths use local validation only and do not provide copy-on-write isolation.

ai-gateway.runtime_only_rationale: Program Runtime reaches ai-gateway through its governed Connect binding boundary; no source-level package import is expected.
ai-gateway.description: Optional typed inference provider for governed classify, extract, and judge calls.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: Program execution and non-inference bindings remain available; inference calls fail closed with an explicit provider-unavailable error.

agent-manager.runtime_only_rationale: Program Runtime reaches agent-manager through its governed delegated-run Connect boundary; no source-level package import is expected.
agent-manager.description: Optional delegated-agent workflow provider for bounded program handles.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Direct governed bindings remain available; delegated runs fail closed with an explicit agent-manager-unavailable error.

search-hub.runtime_only_rationale: Program Runtime reaches search-hub through service discovery and its intent-search boundary; no source-level package import is expected.
search-hub.description: Optional intent-search provider for discovering governed bindings.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Intent resolution falls back to the local manifest registry and reports the fallback provenance.
